senses.gloss: m., pl. סִמְלוֹנִים, סִמְלוֹנִין, סִי׳ (v. סֶמֶל; cmp. γλυφαί, Sm. Ant. s. v. Jugum) the carved ends of a yoke. Sifra B’ḥuck., Par. 1, ch. III קצץ את הס׳ Rabad a. Ar. (ed. סִמְיוֹנִין, סִימְי׳, v. סִמְיוֹן) he cut off the carved ends.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 3:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. III, 13</cite> [read as:] <cite ref="Shabbat 59b:19">Sabb. 59ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בעול הלך אחר סִמְלוֹנָיו</he> as regards the susceptibility of a yoke to levitical uncleanness, go by its carved ends (if they are broken off, the susceptibility ceases); Y. ib. VI, 8ᵇ <he>ונעול אחר סמנייריו</he> (corr. acc.).
